definitions: To have been taken on or chosen by someone or something in the past, prior to another past event.
To have been legally made the child of a person or couple other than one's biological parents, prior to another past event.
To have been formally approved or put into practice, prior to another past event.
examples: The new policy had been adopted before the incident occurred.
She felt loved, knowing she had been adopted into a caring family.
The proposal had been adopted by the committee last month.
